classification: New deterministic engineering checks; source/protocol must be remotely published before first execution.
source_frozen_inputs: All SOURCE_FREEZE.source hashes are verified before any peer starts.
candidate_imports: Only actual Client under test; independent reference frame/HMAC construction uses stdlib. Actual witness and three fake reply peers are separate processes.
cases: Unauthenticated ingress sends brace plus blanks every0.1s; valid authenticated request begins0.1s later and must complete within1.8s, after serial server evicts the slow ingress at its1s absolute frame deadline.
Authenticated request padded to8192 bytes including newline accepted,8193 rejected, next valid request succeeds.
Fake authenticated endpoint sends incomplete response every0.1s; actual Client must time out within3.8s from its3s absolute frame deadline.
Correct authenticated response padded to8192 bytes including newline accepted.
Otherwise correct authenticated response padded to8193 bytes including newline refused.
gate: All five cases and fake peer normal exits must pass with no candidate edits or threshold repairs after opening.
limitations: Sequential finite peers with explicit scheduling margins, not hard realtime or unlimited-flood/global availability, cross-host, concurrent-owner, key compromise or power-loss qualification.
